aiVerification.summary: Comparable SP-B laser cut-body process test, but the draft misgroups outcomes and uses incorrect function/gap comparisons.
issues: Function subresults use wrong Normal rows for 2025-11-01 and total comparisons.
Coil+SP gap outcome is parsed as invalid measurements instead of NG rate comparison.
Changed factor should focus on SP-B changed cut-body laser process versus Normal; supplier is not row-evidenced.
Outcome evidence omits key total comparison rows in subresults.
Some cited rows are headers or unclear extracted rows, reducing evidence quality.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to SP-B changed cut-body laser process compared with Normal production.
Rebuild function outcomes by date and total: row30 vs row32, row34 vs row36, row38 vs row40.
Rebuild Coil+SP gap outcome using rows21-26, especially total SP Test row25 versus Total Normal row26.
Remove invalid measurement-stat outcomes derived from headers.
Cite purpose/title, result tables, totals, and decision rows 47-49.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but final evidence must cite actual data and total rows, not header-only rows.
